comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A Memorial Album consisting of seven items which must be created by modifying base items with transmutation alchemy and "Sophia" points. Related to Legacy TH5. After the Giant Statue though I do not believe you need all the discoveries to unlock each recipe (if I'm wrong, I'll note this later).

MA Items:

Helios' Earrings
Flame Spear
Chares' Architectural Technology Book
Picture of the Colossus (received automatically on discovering the center Legacy)
Helios
Spade
Sailors' Large Torch

The MA can be reported to Ali Reis(Hormuz). The reward is: Ring of the Sun God Helios
Details on its page.

As with other Legacy MAs, special character nicknames are awarded for completing the MA and obtaining its reward. These will be added later when the translated versions are known.

Source: wittyship.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1290.html

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: The English name of this MA is "Remnants of the Colossus".
